claimedEvidence.claim:
Read the one-line patch (patches/review-candidate.patch: SESSION_TTL_SECONDS 24h → 30m in service.py:12), applied it to a scratch copy in /tmp (repo untouched), and ran the suite plus targeted behavioural probes. Baseline: 6/6 tests pass. Patched: 1 failure. Verdict: NOT safe to merge as-is — it breaks a recorded contract test, and its justification ("align with the documented 30-minute inactivity window") is factually wrong because the service has no inactivity semantics at all.
